info.title: dotnet-morphir
info.description: Morphir CLI tool for working with Morphir IR

commands.name: compile
commands.description: Compile source code to Morphir IR

options.name: --extension-id
options.description: Installed frontend full extension identity; mutually exclusive with --extension

options.name: --input
options.description: Source files in compilation order, or one directory

options.name: --project-file
options.description: A build-tool project file that names the ordered sources, for example an .fsproj

options.name: --project
options.description: Project directory, workspace member path or project name

options.name: --ir-version
options.description: IR format version, for example 3, 4 or 4.0.0; overrides ir.format_version

options.name: --json-lines
options.description: Output compile events as JSON Lines, ending with the report

options.name: --output
options.description: Install a copy of the IR in this directory. Files that an earlier install did not write stay unchanged

options.name: --out-dir
options.description: Out root for the compile task; overrides MORPHIR_OUT_DIR and workspace.out_dir

options.name: --target
options.description: Generation target to run on the compiled IR, for example fsharp or csharp

options.name: --generate-output
options.description: Owned output directory of the generation; needed with --target

commands.name: config
commands.description: Inspect and edit Morphir configuration

options.name: --show-origin
options.description: Include winning source paths and positions

options.name: --project
options.description: Inspect one project primary by name or workspace-relative path

options.name: --config
options.description: Overlay an explicitly selected configuration file

options.name: --discovery-boundary
options.description: Bound discovery to this directory and its descendants (default: MORPHIR_DISCOVERY_BOUNDARY, else the filesystem root)

options.name: --profiles
options.description: Comma-separated profile names; repeatable in order

options.name: --isolated
options.description: Exclude machine and personal files; accepts true or false (default: MORPHIR_ISOLATED, else false)

options.name: --suppress-warning
options.description: Suppress a supported warning code; repeatable

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Generate artifacts from a Morphir model

options.name: --input
options.description: Model file or Ion tree. Without it, the IR of the most recent morphir compile of the project

options.name: --extension-id
options.description: Installed backend full extension identity; mutually exclusive with --extension

options.name: --project
options.description: Project directory, workspace member path or project name, for input from a prior compile and its configuration

options.name: --config
options.description: Explicit configuration file, for input from a prior compile and [codegen.<target>].extension

options.name: --out-dir
options.description: Out root that holds the compile record; overrides MORPHIR_OUT_DIR and workspace.out_dir

commands.description: Verify Morphir IR JSON against schema

options.name: --schema-version
options.description: Schema version to validate against (1, 2, or 3). Auto-detected if not specified.

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress output, return only exit code (0 = valid, 1 = invalid)

arguments.name: file-path
arguments.description: Path to the Morphir IR JSON file to verify
